business_problem: Today's telecom networks generate massive volumes of complex data. Traditionally, managing this has been a highly manual process, with operators spending hours digging through minor alert logs to find the root cause of network issues.
solution_summary: At the infrastructure level, Nokia built its foundations on Google Cloud. By moving workloads to standard compute and storage-specifically Google Kubernetes Engine and Cloud Storage-Nokia broke down historical data silos. This provides operators with a single, unified view across their highly complex multi-cloud, multi-vendor, and multi-domain environments, crucially eliminating the need to "rip and replace" their existing infrastructure investments. Finally, at the agent level, Nokia utilized the Google Cloud Agent Development Kit and the Gemini Enterprise to integrate a dynamic ecosystem of six specialized AI agents into the Assurance Center. Each agent plays a specific, coordinated role in troubleshooting. An event triage agent instantly analyzes incoming network alarms, cutting through massive volumes of background noise to isolate actual critical infrastructure threats.
